name: Daredevil: Hell's Kitchen Heroes
notes: Daredevil has haste and vigilance, lets you look at the top card any time, and every attack exiles that card for you to play this turn. 34 Hero cards mean he usually also gets +2/+1, and the Hell's Kitchen crew from Jumpstart (Matt Murdock, Foggy Nelson, Elektra, Stick and a second Daredevil) turns the damage he takes into cards and burn.

Turns 1–3: Quicksilver (which can start the game in play), Matt Murdock, Iron Fist, Hero for Hire and Colleen Wing. Matt Murdock puts a counter on something each combat and gives countered creatures ward.

Turns 4–6: Daredevil attacks for a free card every turn. Daredevil, Fearless Fighter redirects damage you take to an opponent, and Stick turns that damage into another card. Luke Cage, Hero for Hire and Heroes for Hire make Treasure.

Closing: Captain America, Super-Soldier gives your Heroes hexproof, Skybound gives every attacker a counter and indestructible, The Super Hero Civil War steals two blockers; Thor, Asgard's Avenger adds 1 damage to everything else you deal. Lightning Bolt, Ultimate Alliance and Fall to Earth clear blockers.

Bracket 2: No tutors, combos or extra turns. Daredevil, Fearless Fighter deals damage to you when he reveals cards; Foggy Nelson and Matt Murdock help protect your key Heroes. Nico Minoru deals 2 to each opponent every time Daredevil plays a card from exile. Kate Bishop (Hawkeye, Young Avenger) adds her power to all your noncombat damage to opponents, so Hawkeye's Bow, Nico and Lightning Bolt each hit for 2 more. Avengers Assemble! is the top upgrade if you find it (swap out Spider-Man, Web-Slinger).

Set tags: MSH = Marvel Super Heroes, SPM = Marvel's Spider-Man, MSC = Marvel Super Heroes Commander and Jumpstart cards. Every card listed is one you own. Hot Dog Cart and Dependable Quinjet are in all five Marvel B2 decks; some other commons and uncommons are shared too.

variants.name: Daredevil (Nov 15 speed package)
notes: Nov 15 generic sim (4,000 solo games, 5,000 four-player pods): mana on turn 4 went from 3.84 to 4.31 and pod win rate from 22.0% to 24.9%. The only speed package in the vault that moved win rate. The tested version also swapped five basics for Command Tower, Clifftop Retreat, Furycalm Snarl, Spectator Seating and Radiant Summit; the lands alone added nothing, so they are left out.
Against: Hex Magic is one of the deck's few refills, and a rock is a poor card to exile off the top with Daredevil's attack trigger.
All six cards were already on Cards to add as 'verify'. Check for loose copies before sleeving.
